contract_sum.description: Total contract/subcontract price or lump sum. Parser rejects <1000 as a clause-number artefact.

dispute_resolution_path.description: The contract's dispute escalation ladder, in order (e.g. negotiation, mediation, expert determination, arbitration, litigation).
dispute_resolution_path.x-demiton-unit: ordered list of step names, as written

eot_grounds.description: Pre-classified grounds on which this contract allows an extension of time to be claimed, so an event fact (e.g. a rain day) can be matched against its clause without free-text parsing at dispatch time.

indemnity_scope.description: The indemnity clause's scope and any cap or carve-outs, recorded verbatim.

insurance_requirements.description: Insurance types and minimum cover the contract requires - each entry an object with insurance_type, min_limit and endorsements - for cross-joining against insurance_certificate.expires_on.

ld_cap.description: Liquidated damages ceiling (cross-refs the contract_penalty shelf's rate/cap fields).

ld_rate.description: Liquidated damages rate per calendar day.

notice_eot_days.description: Contractual notice window to raise a delay / extension-of-time claim after the delaying event.

notice_latent_conditions_days.description: Contractual notice window to notify latent or differing site conditions after they are encountered.

notice_suspension_days.description: Contractual notice window before a right to suspend work may be exercised.

notice_variation_days.description: Contractual notice window after a variation-triggering event, before which a variation claim must be raised or is time-barred.

payment_timing_days.description: Contract time for payment of a payment claim.

practical_completion_date.description: Date for Practical Completion / Date for Completion, verbatim.
practical_completion_date.x-demiton-unit: free text as written (e.g. "11 January 2027", "26 weeks after Date of Contract")

retention_pct.description: Retention/security percentage of the contract price.

retention_release_milestones.description: Milestones at which retention is reduced or released - each entry an object naming the trigger (e.g. practical completion, end of defects liability) and the amount or percentage released.

security.description: Form/amount of security, e.g. two unconditional undertakings totalling 5%.

security_expiry.description: Date the security (bank guarantee / undertaking) is returnable.

security_release_milestones.description: Milestones at which security is reduced or released - each entry an object naming the trigger and the amount or percentage released.

time_bar_days.description: Window after the notice above within which the substantiated claim itself must be submitted, or it is time-barred (NEC-style two-stage notice/substantiation).
